top_signals.title: German parliament passes law giving spy agencies hacking, sabotage powers
top_signals.summary: In the biggest overhaul of the country’s spy laws of the postwar era, the Bundestag approved the bill by 308 votes to 190 — with 71 abstentions — months after Chancellor Friedrich Merz’s cabinet signed off on the draft.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
